start.basis: Actual audio origin; static opening preroll before first speech

source_spans.exact_narration: Open the menu at the upper left and choose Settings.

At the top, App Info shows App Name, Version and Environment; this example identifies Resgrid IC in development. That gives a command aide useful details when reporting a problem. For practice, locate those three values, then find the Account section directly underneath before reviewing connection or sign-in settings.
In Settings, Account, open Server to inspect the connection address.

The form shows Custom and a complete Server URL; the loopback address here belongs to this local training environment. Use the address supplied by your administrator for your own installation. The note says to leave off the API version path and a trailing slash. Cancel closes this review without saving a different server. During a command handover, comparing the address first helps avoid troubleshooting the wrong installation. Practice finding the complete address rather than relying on the shortened Account row.
Back in Account, choose Sign-in and security.

Responder approvals lists Macintosh with Approvals stopped. Recent verifications reports no verifications in the last thirty days. These are separate facts, so check each rather than treating one heading as a general security verdict. If your department requires another method, arrange its approved setup separately. This review does not enroll an authenticator or create a passkey.

adjacent_same_image_caption_merges.basis: Adjacent exact words on one actual source/scene; retain both genuine endpoints, including any real intervening speech gap. No estimated time or across-screen merge.

limits: Original frozen image/DOM reviews, scripts and raw/corrected service captions stay unchanged.
Only Root-accepted whole-second source cuts and whole-cue entry frames are used. Integer service formatting is not measured phoneme/UI-operation timing.
Tiny caption pieces merge only on the same actual screenshot and scene, retaining real endpoints and exact words. Merges are explicit; no across-source merge or interpolation.
Full derived-cue PCM QA, actual User listening, final input authoring, encoded-frame/caption review and real browser playback are distinct later checks.
